The '''Kingdom of Cadinth''' was a state located within the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]]. It once allied with the Kingdoms of [[Kingdom of Jaminere|Jaminere]] and [[Kingdom of Barseg|Barseg]], creating the [[Three Allied Kingdoms]]. [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII]] waged a campaign against the kingdoms between [[25,150 BBY]] and [[25,130 BBY]], defeating the Kingdom of Cadinth at the [[Battle of Cadinth (Xer's Campaigns)|Battle of Cadinth]]. The Three Allied Kingdoms worlds were conquered and integrated in [[Kingdom of Cron|Xer's Empire]].
